## Configuration

```{r config}
# --- Configurable Parameters ---

# AR(p) models to test: list of phi coefficient vectors
# Each element is a vector of AR coefficients
ar_models <- list(
  #"AR(1) φ=0.8"  = c(0.8)
  #"AR(1) φ=0.9"  = c(0.9),
  #"AR(1) φ=0.95" = c(0.95),
  #"AR(2) φ=(0.5, 0.3)" = c(0.5, 0.3),
  #"AR(2) φ=(1.0, -0.5)" = c(1.0, -0.5)
)

# Series length
n_obs <- 100

# Number of simulations per model/method combination
n_sims <- 100

# Bootstrap replicates within each test
n_boot <- 500

# Maximum AR order for model fitting
p_max <- 5

# Significance level
alpha <- 0.05

# Random seed for reproducibility
master_seed <- 42

# Criteria to test for MLE (Burg only supports AIC)
mle_criteria <- c("aic")
```

## Stationarity Check

```{r stationarity-check}
cat("=== Stationarity Check ===\n\n")

valid_models <- list()

for (model_name in names(ar_models)) {
  phi <- ar_models[[model_name]]
  is_stationary <- check.stationary.tse(phi, tol = 1.0)
  status <- ifelse(is_stationary, "✓ Stationary", "✗ Non-stationary")
  
  cat(sprintf("%s: φ = (%s) - %s\n", 
              model_name, 
              paste(round(phi, 3), collapse = ", "),
              status))
  
  if (is_stationary) {
    valid_models[[model_name]] <- phi
  }
}

if (length(valid_models) == 0) {
  stop("No valid stationary models provided!")
}

if (length(valid_models) < length(ar_models)) {
  cat(sprintf("\nProceeding with %d of %d models.\n", 
              length(valid_models), length(ar_models)))
}

ar_models <- valid_models
```

## Test Variants

We will test all combinations of:

- **Methods:** Burg, MLE
- **Criteria:** AIC, AICC, BIC
- **Adjustment:** Raw, with COBA

Total: 2 methods × 3 criteria × 2 adjustments = 12 variants per model

```{r define-variants}
# Define all test variants (2 methods x 3 criteria = 6 variants)
test_variants <- expand.grid(
  method = c("burg", "mle"),
  criterion = c("aic", "aicc", "bic"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(variant_name = paste0(toupper(method), " + ", toupper(criterion)))

kable(test_variants, 
      col.names = c("Method", "Criterion", "Variant Name"),
      caption = "Test Variants") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), 
                full_width = FALSE)
```

## Run Simulation

Under H0 (no trend), we expect the test to reject approximately `r alpha * 100`% of the time.

```{r run-simulation, cache=TRUE}
set.seed(master_seed)

results <- data.frame()

n_models <- length(ar_models)
n_variants <- nrow(test_variants)
total_tests <- n_models * n_sims * n_variants * 2  # x2 for raw + COBA

cat(sprintf("Models: %d\n", n_models))
cat(sprintf("Simulations per model: %d\n", n_sims))
cat(sprintf("Variants: %d (x2 for raw/COBA)\n", n_variants))
cat(sprintf("Total tests: %d\n\n", total_tests))

for (model_name in names(ar_models)) {
  phi <- ar_models[[model_name]]
  cat(sprintf("Model: %s\n", model_name))
  
  for (sim in 1:n_sims) {
    # Generate AR(p) series under H0 (no trend)
    sim_seed <- master_seed + sim + sum(round(phi * 10000))
    x <- gen.arma.wge(n_obs, phi = phi, plot = FALSE, sn = sim_seed)
    
    # Test each variant
    for (v in 1:nrow(test_variants)) {
      method <- test_variants$method[v]
      criterion <- test_variants$criterion[v]
      variant_name <- test_variants$variant_name[v]
      
      # Create stat function
      stat_fn <- make.stat.co.tse(maxp = p_max, ar_method = method, 
                                   criterion = criterion)
      
      # Run bootstrap test
      result <- tryCatch({
        wbg.boot.test.tse(x, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = n_boot, p_max = p_max,
                          ar_method = method, criterion = criterion,
                          bootadj = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, parallel = TRUE)
      }, error = function(e){
        message(sprintf("  [Error] Model: %s | Sim: %d | Method: %s | Criterion: %s - %s",
                        model_name, sim, method, criterion, e$message))
      })
      
      if (!is.null(result)) {
        # Raw (no COBA)
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          model = model_name,
          sim = sim,
          method = method,
          criterion = criterion,
          variant = variant_name,
          adjusted = FALSE,
          pvalue = result$pvalue_two,
          reject = result$pvalue_two < alpha,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
        
        # With COBA
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          model = model_name,
          sim = sim,
          method = method,
          criterion = criterion,
          variant = variant_name,
          adjusted = TRUE,
          pvalue = result$pvalue_two_adj,
          reject = result$pvalue_two_adj < alpha,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  cat("  done\n")
}

cat("\nSimulation complete!\n")
```

## Results

### Summary Table

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- results %>%
  group_by(model, method, criterion, variant, adjusted) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    n_reject = sum(reject),
    obs_sig_level = mean(reject),
    se = sqrt(obs_sig_level * (1 - obs_sig_level) / n_tests),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variant_label = paste0(variant, ifelse(adjusted, " + COBA", "")),
    obs_pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", obs_sig_level * 100),
    ci = sprintf("(%.1f%%, %.1f%%)", 
                 pmax(0, (obs_sig_level - 1.96 * se)) * 100,
                 (obs_sig_level + 1.96 * se) * 100),
    calibrated = abs(obs_sig_level - alpha) <= 2 * se,
    inflated = obs_sig_level > alpha + 2 * se
  )

kable(summary_table %>% 
        select(model, variant_label, n_tests, obs_pct, ci) %>%
        rename(Model = model,
               Method = variant_label,
               `N Tests` = n_tests,
               `Obs. Sig. Level` = obs_pct,
               `95% CI` = ci),
      caption = sprintf("Observed Significance Levels (Nominal α = %.0f%%)", alpha * 100)) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), 
                font_size = 11) %>%
  row_spec(which(summary_table$inflated), background = "#ffcccc") %>%
  row_spec(which(summary_table$calibrated), background = "#ccffcc")
```

*Green: Well-calibrated (within 2 SE of nominal `r alpha*100`%)*
*Red: Inflated (significantly above nominal)*

### Comparison by Model

```{r plot-by-model, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
plot_data <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = names(ar_models)))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = variant_label, y = obs_sig_level, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, obs_sig_level - 1.96 * se), 
                    ymax = obs_sig_level + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = alpha, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~model, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("burg" = "steelblue", "mle" = "darkorange")) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed Significance Levels by Model and Method",
    subtitle = sprintf("Nominal α = %.0f%% (red dashed) | n = %d | %d sims | %d bootstrap reps",
                       alpha * 100, n_obs, n_sims, n_boot),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Observed Significance Level",
    fill = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )
```

### Method Comparison (Averaged Across Models)

```{r method-comparison, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
method_summary <- summary_table %>%
  group_by(variant_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sig_level = mean(obs_sig_level),
    se = sd(obs_sig_level) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(abs(mean_sig_level - alpha))

ggplot(method_summary, aes(x = reorder(variant_label, abs(mean_sig_level - alpha)), 
                            y = mean_sig_level, fill = variant_label)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_sig_level - 1.96 * se,
                    ymax = mean_sig_level + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = alpha, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Significance Level Across All Models",
    subtitle = "Ordered by distance from nominal (best on left)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Observed Significance Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

### COBA Improvement

```{r coba-improvement}
coba_comparison <- summary_table %>%
  select(model, variant, adjusted, obs_sig_level) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = adjusted, values_from = obs_sig_level,
              names_prefix = "adj_") %>%
  mutate(
    raw = adj_FALSE,
    with_coba = adj_TRUE,
    improvement = raw - with_coba,
    pct_improvement = improvement / raw * 100
  ) %>%
  select(model, variant, raw, with_coba, improvement)

kable(coba_comparison %>%
        mutate(across(c(raw, with_coba, improvement), ~sprintf("%.3f", .))) %>%
        rename(Model = model,
               Method = variant,
               Raw = raw,
               `With COBA` = with_coba,
               `Improvement` = improvement),
      caption = "COBA Adjustment Effect (positive = COBA reduces inflation)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

### P-value Distributions

```{r pvalue-dist, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
results %>%
  mutate(
    variant_label = paste0(variant, ifelse(adjusted, " + COBA", "")),
    model = factor(model, levels = names(ar_models))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pvalue)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = alpha, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_grid(model ~ variant_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "P-value Distributions Under H0",
    subtitle = "Should be approximately uniform if well-calibrated",
    x = "P-value",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

## Summary

```{r final-summary}
cat("=== Configuration ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Series length: %d\n", n_obs))
cat(sprintf("Simulations per condition: %d\n", n_sims))
cat(sprintf("Bootstrap replicates: %d\n", n_boot))
cat(sprintf("Nominal α: %.0f%%\n\n", alpha * 100))

cat("=== Best Method by Model ===\n\n")

best_by_model <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(dist_from_nominal = abs(obs_sig_level - alpha)) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  slice_min(dist_from_nominal, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

for (i in 1:nrow(best_by_model)) {
  row <- best_by_model[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%s:\n  Best: %s (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
              row$model, row$variant_label, row$obs_sig_level * 100))
}

cat("=== Overall Ranking (by mean distance from nominal) ===\n\n")

overall_ranking <- summary_table %>%
  group_by(variant_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sig = mean(obs_sig_level),
    mean_dist = mean(abs(obs_sig_level - alpha)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_dist)

for (i in 1:nrow(overall_ranking)) {
  row <- overall_ranking[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%d. %s (mean = %.1f%%, dist = %.3f)\n", 
              i, row$variant_label, row$mean_sig * 100, row$mean_dist))
}
```
